national_sources.name: the Reserve Bank of New Zealand

notes.inflation: New Zealand measures its consumers price index quarterly, not monthly, so the inflation figures update four times a year; the rates are worked out to one decimal place from Stats NZ's all-items index, as republished by the OECD. The interest rate is the Reserve Bank's official cash rate, shown from April 1999, the first full month of the OCR.
notes.labour: Unemployment is from Stats NZ's Household Labour Force Survey, which is quarterly. Employment and participation rates are not shown yet: no confirmed open source carries them on the same basis.
notes.trade: Goods trade from the IMF's international trade in goods data, converted from US dollars to New Zealand dollars at each month's exchange rate, so figures can differ slightly from Stats NZ's own. All three series end at the latest month for which both exports and imports are published.
notes.public: Debt and the budget balance are the IMF World Economic Outlook's general government figures on calendar years, actual years only. They differ from the Treasury's core Crown measures, which use the June fiscal year.
notes.markets: The 10-year yield is the OECD's monthly average of the New Zealand government bond yield; the exchange rate is the Federal Reserve's daily rate.
